messages:
alex: Planning a short canary rollout for model-service v2.3 -> prod at 18:00 UTC (30m window). I'm the deploy owner. Quick asks: runbook link below, rollback commands, smoke checklist. Can the oncall and QA own watches? @maria @jonathan @sam

maria: Ack, I can watch the canary. Smoke tests I’ll run: /health, 3 sample prompts (100t, 512t), embedding consistency check. Will post results in this thread.

jonathan: I validated infra toggles: db-migration flag is off, feature flag `route_v2` is in canary mode. Suggest: 15m canary at 10% traffic, then ramp to 50% for 10m if no regressions, then full. Rollback criteria: errors > 1.5x baseline OR median p95 latency increase > 200ms.

sam: I’ll trigger the automated smoke script and tail logs. Where’s the runbook?

alex: Runbook here: https://confluence.internal/redwood/offramp-readiness/v2.3-runbook — section "Offramp & Revert" has exact kill-switch steps. Quick commands I’ll paste here for visibility:

```
# immediate rollback (manual)
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/model-service
# or set previous image explicitly
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/model-service model-service=redwood/model:v2.2
# feature flag fallback
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/toggle -d '{"flag":"route_v2","value":false}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLAG_KEY"
```

alex: Keep the canary window short. If anyone sees data anomalies (embedding drift, hallucination spike), call go/no-go immediately and we flip the toggle.

sre-bot: Note: There is a non-prod maintenance job at 18:10 UTC but it does NOT touch prod. No conflicts detected.

maria: Smoke results (18:08 UTC): /health OK, sample prompts OK, embed similarity within threshold. Latencies: p95 ~ 120ms (baseline 100ms). No errors. :white_check_mark:

jonathan: Infra checks good. I’ll stand by for canary rollout and monitor autoscaler & GPU saturation. If autoscaler behaves oddly, I’ll reduce replicas. ACK.

sam: Running canary script now, tailing logs. If I see >0.5% 5xx I'll alert and start rollback steps. ACK :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks all — initiating 10% canary at 18:12 UTC. I’ll post updates every 5m. If no objections, proceed with ramp plan.
